method: The listed wholewheat pasta quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Use unseasoned mince made from 100% skinless turkey breast, weighed raw. Commercial mixed-cut turkey mince is not the specified ingredient; ask the butcher for breast mince or mince skinless breast at home.
Bring a saucepan of water to the boil. The 75g wholewheat pasta, dry is a dry weight: cook according to its packet until tender, then drain, saving a small cup of pasta water.
Dice the courgette, cherry tomatoes into bite-size pieces. Measure the peri-peri sauce ready to add near the end of cooking.

Heat half the measured olive oil in a non-stick frying pan. Add the turkey breast mince, break it into small pieces with a spoon and fry over medium-high heat for about 8–10 minutes. Keep turning until browned and steaming hot throughout; check the centre reaches 75°C for 30 seconds with a clean thermometer. Transfer the cooked filling to a clean plate.
Add the remaining measured olive oil and courgette, cherry tomatoes to the pan. Cook over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, stirring until the courgette softens and the tomatoes release their juices.

Add the cooked pasta and filling. Stir in the measured peri-peri sauce and 2 tablespoons of cooking water. Heat gently for 1–2 minutes, stirring until the coating is hot. Toss gently, using another spoonful of reserved pasta water if it needs loosening. Serve immediately.
